_about: telegram-stories config. Keys starting with _ are comments. Omitted keys use the defaults from scripts/tgstories/config.py.
_channels: Your channels whose stories should be tracked, e.g. ["@mychannel"]. Telegram shows channel admins counts, reactions and reposts, not viewers.

notify._via: auto = the agent's bot if TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and a chat are known, else Saved Messages; bot | saved | none

autoresponder._enabled: Global switch. While false, rules can be created and run in shadow mode, but nothing is sent.
autoresponder._never_message: User ids or @usernames that must never get an automatic message.
